title: Coding interviews
description: Recognize common DSA patterns, explain your reasoning, and practice under a time limit.

milestones.title: Build the foundations
milestones.description: Get comfortable turning a prompt into a correct program and describing its cost.

skills.title: Arrays and hash maps
skills.description: Track counts, membership, and first occurrences in one pass. Use prefix sums for range queries.

skills.title: Binary search and complexity
skills.description: State the search invariant and compare the time and space costs of linear and binary search.

milestones.title: Learn common patterns
milestones.description: Identify what changes as you scan a sequence, process an interval, or visit a graph.

skills.title: Stacks, two pointers, and sliding windows
skills.description: Practice nested matching, moving pointers inward, and maintaining a window invariant.

skills.title: Linked lists and trees
skills.description: Practice changing links without losing the rest of the list and following child links to traverse a tree.

skills.title: Intervals and greedy choices
skills.description: Sort intervals by the relevant endpoint and explain why each choice is safe.

skills.title: Graph traversal
skills.description: Use BFS for shortest paths in unweighted graphs and a visited set for connected components.

milestones.title: Prepare for the interview
milestones.description: Practice coming up with an approach out loud before writing code.

skills.title: Recursion and backtracking
skills.description: Define a base case and a smaller subproblem. Undo a choice when a search path fails.

skills.title: Dynamic programming
skills.description: Define a state, base case, and transition. Check unreachable states and estimate complexity.

skills.title: Timed mock interview
skills.description: Solve one problem in 35 minutes. Spend the final five minutes testing edge cases and justifying complexity.

title: Backend engineering
description: Build a service with a database, background jobs, and a deployment you can explain.

milestones.title: Build an API
milestones.description: Pick a domain such as jobs, inventory, or tasks and expose it through a small REST service.

skills.title: HTTP APIs and validation
skills.description: Create, list, and update resources. Validate input and return useful status codes and errors.

skills.title: SQL and transactions
skills.description: Model related tables, write a join, and make a change that updates two tables in one transaction.

milestones.title: Process jobs in the background
milestones.description: Add a queued task and give clients a way to check its status.

skills.title: Message queues and worker pools
skills.description: Use RabbitMQ to hand jobs to bounded consumers. Acknowledge a job after its result is saved.

skills.title: Retries and idempotency
skills.description: Give each job a stable identifier and verify that delivering the same job twice changes state only once.

milestones.title: Package and demonstrate
milestones.description: Make it possible for someone else to run the service and follow a job from request to result.

skills.title: Docker and service health
skills.description: Start your app and dependencies with Compose. Add health checks and configure secrets through the environment.

skills.title: Backend portfolio project
skills.description: Record a short demo and explain the schema, job lifecycle, and one tradeoff you made.

title: Full stack development
description: Ship a responsive app with a real API, account flows, and end-to-end verification.

milestones.title: Build the interface
milestones.description: Start with a user task that fits in one screen and works on mobile.

skills.title: React state and components
skills.description: Build a searchable list and an edit form with clear loading, error, and empty states.

skills.title: Responsive and accessible UI
skills.description: Check keyboard navigation, form labels, focus, and the layout at phone widths.

milestones.title: Connect the backend
milestones.description: Store user data and connect the interface to a real service.

skills.title: HTTP APIs and validation
skills.description: Create, list, and update resources. Validate input and return useful status codes and errors.

skills.title: Authentication and data ownership
skills.description: Protect user routes on the server and verify that one account cannot read or modify another account’s records.

milestones.title: Ship a portfolio app
milestones.description: Show a complete workflow that a reviewer can try.

skills.title: End-to-end testing
skills.description: Test a primary workflow from sign-in through data creation and verify one meaningful failure case.

skills.title: Docker and service health
skills.description: Start your app and dependencies with Compose. Add health checks and configure secrets through the environment.

skills.title: Full stack portfolio project
skills.description: Add sample data, a short demo, and instructions for running the app. Explain one UI decision and one API decision.
